title: character-observation
description: Per-role observation schema for a character record at doing/governing/characters/<name>/<name>.md. A character is the on-disk entity the harness binds to via CHARACTER_NAME; its frontmatter cells include those of the agent form (a character bears the agent form) plus any character-specific cells. Frontmatter conformance to the agent form is enforced by $ref to work/governance/rules/specifications/agent/schema.json.
